nodes.label: MVP completed: extraction (#6-#8), render PNG/SVG and HTML (#9, #10), kg remove/edit (#28), agent guide (#11), MVP validation (#12), cleanup (#33) and v0.2 planning
nodes.description:
Goal: finish the v0.1 MVP after the English migration (#20) and plan v0.2.
Instructions: user works issue by issue, merges PRs himself and confirms each commit/PR; graph texts in a single language (English for published examples); credit authors of example repos and use only licensed repos; no prio on new issues until asked, then prio:v0.2 for #35-#40.
Discoveries: the samples/basic-python-cli store holds hand-written nodes with false parser provenance (kg add never deletes); 3 hues is the max palette passing all-pairs CVD; HTML layout of 292 visible nodes blocks 2.9 s; CLI start-up ~1 s is the matplotlib import; GitHub Pages needed a public repo and the .env token returns 403 for Pages, so the user enabled it by hand; the assistant once committed 9790c4d without asking and then left the cleanup uncommitted until told.
Accomplished: PRs #23-#34 merged (issues #20, #6, #7, #8, #9, #28, #10, #11, #12, #33 closed); RF-75/RF-76 added; docs/extract.md, docs/render.md, docs/mvp-validation.md, docs/discovery.md written; examples published at cristian1a.github.io/kg/examples/; issues #35-#40 opened with prio:v0.2; About description proposed.
Next steps: v0.2 in order #37 (consistency) -> #38 (kg query/impact) -> #39 benchmark / #40 demo, plus #35 (HTML performance) and #36 (mandatory descriptions); decide how to clean the samples/basic-python-cli store.
Relevant files: src/kg/extract/, src/kg/render/, src/kg/edit.py, src/kg/agents/guide.md, src/kg/analysis.py, docs/mvp-validation.md, docs/examples/, examples/agent/*.json, tests/test_flow.py.

Functional requirements v1.0 approved: name kg, <type>:<slug> IDs, interactive HTML
nodes.description:
What: requirements v1.0 approved 2026-10-07 (~40 RF-xx MVP/v0.2/Future, 9 RNF, 6 use cases, 5 MVP acceptance criteria); PA-01 name 'kg', PA-02 IDs <type>:<slug>, PA-03 interactive HTML (originally pyvis/vis.js).
Why: requirements gathered by an interview where the user played the client; now condensed in English in docs/discovery.md.
Where: docs/requirements.md (sections 9 and 10); docs/discovery.md.
Learned: PA-03 was amended on 2026-10-12 to embed vis-network directly instead of pyvis (decision:embed-vis-network-not-pyvis); RF-75/RF-76 (kg remove/edit) were added to the MVP.

nodes.label: CLI quirk noticed in PR #13 review: command=null on usage errors
nodes.description:
What: usage errors set "command": null in the JSON envelope even when the subcommand is recognized (kg --json render). The stub exit-code point is gone (PR #30 removed _not_implemented) and the language point went away with PR #22.
Why: raised as points to confirm before merging #13; none breaks anything.
Where: src/kg/cli.py.
Learned: only the command=null point remains open.

nodes.label: Issue #7: dependencies and configuration from manifests (merged via PR #25)
nodes.description:
What: Config and Dependency nodes from pyproject.toml and requirements*.txt.
Why: MVP extraction RF-11.
Where: src/kg/extract/deps.py
Learned: Poetry, setup.py and setup.cfg are not read.

nodes.label: Issue #8: pytest test detection and tests edges (merged via PR #26)
nodes.description:
What: Test nodes and tests edges; kg.analysis.untested().
Why: MVP extraction RF-12, CU-02.
Where: src/kg/extract/references.py, src/kg/analysis.py
Learned: On kg itself: 456 nodes, 862 edges, 39 public definitions with no direct test.

nodes.label: Issue #9: kg render --png/--svg (merged via PR #27)
nodes.description:
What: Static render with --types, --max-nodes, --dpi.
Why: RF-50; first visualization of CU-01.
Where: src/kg/render/static.py, style.py
Learned: --dpi was added at the user's request as a zoom stopgap; the basic-python-cli image was not put in the README because of mixed languages.

nodes.label: Issue #28: kg remove and kg edit (merged via PR #29)
nodes.description:
What: Delete nodes/edges and modify nodes from the CLI; RF-75/RF-76.
Why: Client asked for it after seeing stale nodes in the basic-python-cli store; the store only grew.
Where: src/kg/edit.py, docs/store.md
Learned: Tried on a copy of the sample store only.

nodes.label: Issue #10: interactive offline HTML (merged via PR #30)
nodes.description:
What: kg render --html with zoom/pan, legend-filters, search, details panel, deep links, dark theme.
Why: RF-51..55; MVP acceptance criterion 4; user explicitly asked for zoom and click-for-details.
Where: src/kg/render/html.py, src/kg/render/assets/template.html
Learned: Verified in headless Chrome; tests/test_html.py has a Chrome test skipped without Chrome.

nodes.label: Issue #11: kg guide for agents (merged via PR #31)
nodes.description:
What: Agent guidelines shipped in the package plus kg add --dry-run; trial examples/agent/kg.json on kg itself.
Why: RF-20, RF-24: kg never calls an LLM, agents need testable instructions.
Where: src/kg/agents/guide.md, .agents/skills/kg-graph/SKILL.md
Learned: Trial validated on the first --dry-run and found a stale sentence in docs/render.md (CU-03 in action).

nodes.label: Issue #12: MVP validation on three repos (merged via PR #32)
nodes.description:
What: Full CU-01 flow on three MIT repos plus kg; report and published examples.
Why: MVP acceptance (section 8 of requirements).
Where: docs/mvp-validation.md, docs/examples/, examples/agent/*.json, tests/test_flow.py
Learned: All five acceptance criteria pass; see experiment:mvp-validation-three-repos.

nodes.label: Issue #33: remove prototypes and Spanish leftovers (merged via PR #34)
nodes.description:
What: Removed root prototypes, lib/, root requirements.txt, src/kg/graphs.py; respuestas_usuario.txt became docs/discovery.md in English.
Why: Keep the repo to the tool, docs and tests, all in English; the root requirements.txt also polluted kg's own graph with transitive deps (numpy, six).
Where: repo root, docs/discovery.md, .agents/tools/graph_summary.py
Learned: Non-ASCII Spanish test data (Tamaño en MB) stays on purpose to test UTF-8; .gitignore now ignores kg-graph.*.

nodes.label: kg extract discovers files with git ls-files, fallback to a simplified .gitignore walk
nodes.description:
What: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard inside a work tree; otherwise walk with a root-.gitignore matcher; env/, .venv/, .git/, __pycache__/, caches and any dir with pyvenv.cfg always skipped; unparsable files reported and skipped.
Why: Respect every .gitignore without reimplementing it; never abort the whole extraction.
Where: src/kg/extract/files.py
Learned: Python 3.12 raises SyntaxError (not ValueError) for null bytes.

nodes.label: Dependencies: one node per PEP 503 normalized name, stdlib imports ignored, manifest provenance wins
nodes.description:
What: Dependency IDs use the normalized name; code imports use the import name; stdlib imports create no node; kg extract combines manifests first, so a dep declared and imported is one node with joined attrs (spec/extras/markers from first declaration, groups, declared_in, import_name).
Why: Avoid noise from stdlib and duplicates across manifests and code.
Where: src/kg/extract/deps.py, extract_repo()/combine()
Learned: Import name != distribution name (yaml vs PyYAML) still gives two nodes until RF-32 (v0.2).

nodes.label: kg add and kg extract share merge.add_document()
nodes.description:
What: One validation and merge path for both commands, so re-extracting leaves the store byte-identical.
Why: MVP acceptance criterion 5 (no duplicates on re-extraction).
Where: src/kg/merge.py
Learned: Moved functions are reported as conflicts on every re-extraction; text output lists at most 10, --json all.

nodes.label: Tests become Test nodes (test:<qualname>) replacing Module/Class/Function; tests edges are static and direct
nodes.description:
What: pytest conventions detect test modules/classes/functions; each entity keeps a single node; tests edges go from test modules to imported internal modules and from test functions to code their body references, never to tests, helpers or conftest.
Why: Basis for CU-02 'which tests are missing'.
Where: src/kg/extract/python.py, src/kg/extract/references.py
Learned: untested means 'no test references it directly', not 'never executed'; fixtures, indirect calls (needs calls, RF-13), getattr/importlib and string monkeypatch are invisible; old stores keep stale module:/function: test nodes and should be recreated (not marked breaking: no release yet).

nodes.label: Render encoding: color = family (3 hues), marker shape = type
nodes.description:
What: Code blue, tests green, context orange, other gray; shape per type, custom types get a stable name-derived shape (10 shapes, 1-in-10 collisions possible); shared style.py with dark variants for HTML.
Why: Only 3 hues pass all-pairs distinguishability incl. CVD; type must never rely on color alone.
Where: src/kg/render/style.py
Learned: First version had Function and Module (and two custom types) with identical markers; fixed after looking at real renders.

nodes.label: Static render uses matplotlib Figure API (no pyplot), seed 42 layout and hides whole types down to 150 nodes
nodes.description:
What: spring layout seed=42 with nodes sorted by ID; PNG without Software metadata, SVG without date and fixed IDs; above --max-nodes (default 150) hide Function, Test, File, Class in that order; agent types (Document, Decision, Concept, Service, Endpoint) always labeled.
Why: RNF-08 determinism and AGENTS.md rule 7 (no plt.show()); with 300 nodes the tests swamped the structure.
Where: src/kg/render/static.py
Learned: Above 500 nodes NetworkX spring layout needs scipy, not a dependency; kg fails with a clear message.

nodes.label: Embed vis-network 9.1.2 inline instead of depending on pyvis (PA-03 amended)
nodes.description:
What: kg render --html writes one self-contained ~500 KB page with graph JSON (</>/& escaped), page code and vis-network inline; works offline from file://.
Why: pyvis's template lacks filters, search and the details panel, so it would be rewritten anyway, and pyvis pulls ipython, jinja2 and jsonpickle.
Where: src/kg/render/html.py, src/kg/render/assets/ (README keeps license header)
Learned: The bundled vis-network.min.js is the same file pyvis 0.3.2 ships; user may revert if he prefers pyvis.

nodes.label: The HTML is read-only and shows copyable kg edit/kg remove commands
nodes.description:
What: Edits and deletions happen through the CLI; the details panel offers the matching command for the selected element.
Why: A self-contained offline HTML has no server and cannot write to the store (out of scope, section 9); the JSON-patch export alternative was not chosen.
Where: src/kg/render/assets/template.html
Learned: All repo text is inserted with textContent.

nodes.label: kg remove / kg edit are all-or-nothing, validated before saving, with suggestions
nodes.description:
What: Unknown ID, edge or attribute changes nothing and suggests the closest match; --id rewrites edges via nx.relabel_nodes; empty string removes label/description; provenance kept; --dry-run and --json; no-op edits don't rewrite the file.
Why: Same actionable-error style as kg validate; deterministic store and clean diffs.
Where: src/kg/edit.py, docs/store.md (RF-75, RF-76)
Learned: Edits are not protected from later merges: kg extract restores parser values for elements it produces (RF-31/RF-33, v0.2).

nodes.label: Agent guide ships as package data: kg guide, --skill export kept in sync by a test, plus kg add --dry-run
nodes.description:
What: guide.md covers the loop extract -> write JSON -> kg add --dry-run --json -> fix -> kg add -> render, reusing extracted IDs, llm provenance with a confidence rubric, the minimal catalog (Document, Decision, Concept, Service, Endpoint, Issue, Person) and a single-language rule; agents may add Config nodes for files the parser doesn't read (CI workflows, docker-compose, .env.example).
Why: kg never calls an LLM (RF-24); kg validate is file-local and flags edges to extracted nodes as broken, so agents need a store-aware dry run.
Where: src/kg/agents/guide.md, .agents/skills/kg-graph/SKILL.md
Learned: The guide initially forbade agent Config nodes; relaxed during #12 validation (1b1407c).

nodes.label: All human-readable graph texts in one language; published examples in English
nodes.description:
What: label, description and free-text attrs use a single language (the user's or the project docs'); IDs keep their normal form; agent enrichments of the published examples are in English.
Why: The basic-python-cli render mixed Spanish and English labels and looked inconsistent.
Where: guide.md single-language rule; examples/agent/*.json
Learned: Requested by the user after seeing the render; the #11 criterion originally said Spanish for that sample, then #12 settled on English for published examples.

nodes.label: MVP validation and published examples use only MIT-licensed repos, with credits
nodes.description:
What: alfredodeza/basic-python-cli (easy, d0379bb), bramvdklinkenberg/my_first_data_project (intermediate, 3d57177), wesleey/python-clean-architecture (complex, 6f58de5, 104 files, size exception noted); kg itself as dogfooding. Credits (link, author, license, commit) in README, docs/mvp-validation.md, each page title; license texts in docs/examples/licenses/.
Why: Avoid licensing problems: the first candidates jit-karki/small-python-projects and borys25ol/fastapi-realworld-backend had no license (all rights reserved), so they were dropped and deleted from samples/.
Where: docs/examples/, README Examples section
Learned: my_first_data_project's LICENSE keeps the template placeholder, credited to the account owner; README image is my_first_data_project.png, chosen by the client.

nodes.label: Publish example pages with GitHub Pages from main:/docs
nodes.description:
What: Repo made public; Pages serves docs/ (docs/.nojekyll) so pages live at cristian1a.github.io/kg/examples/<repo>.html, linked from the README.
Why: Needs a public URL for the interactive examples; private-repo Pages needs a paid plan.
Where: docs/.nojekyll, docs/examples/
Learned: The site root 404s (no docs/index.html) by design; the user enabled Pages by hand.

nodes.label: v0.2 plan: #37 consistency -> #38 kg query/impact -> #39 benchmark / #40 demo, plus #35 and #36
nodes.description:
What: External suggestions turned into four prio:v0.2 issues; #35 and #36 also moved to prio:v0.2 and milestone v0.2.
Why: Consistency is a correctness problem seen in the sample store; queries are needed before a fair code-vs-graph benchmark and a demo with queries.
Where: GitHub milestone v0.2
Learned: Benchmark must live outside the kg package (bench/) to respect RF-24; 15-30 questions orient but are not statistically conclusive.

nodes.label: Palette validation: 3 family hues pass all-pairs incl. CVD, 4 do not
nodes.description:
What: Ran the dataviz palette validator on family colors, light and dark.
Why: In a node graph every color pair is visible at once.
Where: src/kg/render/style.py
Learned: 3 hues: CVD dE >= 9.2, normal-vision dE >= 24; with 4 some pair fails; dark palette also validated.

nodes.label: MVP validation on three MIT repos plus kg: all five criteria pass
nodes.description:
What: Full init -> extract -> add -> render with agent enrichment (Claude Code following kg guide), reference questions answered from the graph only, an invalid doc fixed in one iteration, HTML checked in Chrome.
Why: Close the MVP (#12) with evidence.
Where: docs/mvp-validation.md, examples/agent/*.json, tests/test_flow.py
Learned: Every command < 2 s (~1 s is matplotlib import); agent docs passed --dry-run first time; found real doc drift in the sample repos (README says four workflows but lists five; broken link); fixes 9790c4d (sibling imports of scripts inside a package became external deps) and f2600b7 (unlabeled agent types).

nodes.label: HTML layout timing on python-clean-architecture: 2.9 s blocked; full Python layout too slow
nodes.description:
What: Measured vis-network stabilization (400 iterations) on the code-only graph (376 nodes, 292 visible) via Chrome DevTools; timed nx.forceatlas2_layout seed 42.
Why: Investigate the 'Laying out the graph...' hang reported by the user.
Where: issue #35
Learned: 2.9 s with no progress and unresponsive page on a 16-core desktop; forceatlas2: 2.7 s/398 nodes, 3.2 s/609, 35 s/~2000 (O(n^2)), so only the main view should be precomputed.

nodes.label: CLI start-up takes ~1 s because matplotlib is always imported
nodes.description:
What: Every kg command pays ~1 s importing matplotlib.
Why: Found during MVP timing (RNF-06).
Where: src/kg/cli.py, src/kg/render
Learned: Fix: lazy import; listed as v0.2 open point in the report.

nodes.label: untested() reports false positives (__init__, interfaces)
nodes.description:
What: Static direct-reference heuristic flags __init__ and interface methods as untested.
Why: Seen during MVP validation.
Where: src/kg/analysis.py
Learned: Open point for v0.2.

nodes.label: Import name vs distribution name yields duplicate Dependency nodes (RF-32)
nodes.description:
What: yaml (import) and PyYAML (distribution) become two nodes.
Why: No mapping from import names to distributions yet.
Where: src/kg/extract/deps.py, python.py
Learned: Planned as RF-32 in v0.2.

nodes.label: Static layout above 500 nodes needs scipy, which is not a dependency
nodes.description:
What: NetworkX spring layout requires scipy for >500 nodes; kg errors clearly.
Why: Adding scipy was not justified for MVP sizes.
Where: src/kg/render/static.py
Learned: Defaults (150 nodes) never get there.

nodes.label: Issue #35: HTML main view by default, details on demand (prio:v0.2)
nodes.description:
What: Show main nodes (Repo, Package, Module, Dependency, Config, test modules, agent types) by default, rank by degree/PageRank within ~150; expand modules on double-click with local layout; precompute the main view layout in Python (seeded); progress bar and Stop layout.
Why: Large graphs block the page during layout (user's idea first).
Where: src/kg/render/html.py, template.html
Learned: Alternatives considered: vis clustering by package (RF-56) and WebGL renderer (new dependency).

nodes.label: Issue #36: mandatory descriptions for agent-created nodes (prio:v0.2)
nodes.description:
What: Guide requires a 1-2 sentence description on every agent node and on main extracted nodes lacking one; missing_description warning in kg validate/kg add for llm nodes; HTML search also matches descriptions.
Why: Descriptions make the graph fast to search; the client asked for them to be mandatory.
Where: src/kg/agents/guide.md, schema/validate, template.html
Learned: examples/agent/*.json already comply.

nodes.label: Issue #37: keep the graph consistent when the code changes (prio:v0.2, first)
nodes.description:
What: Stale parser nodes (deleted/moved files and symbols) must disappear without losing llm/manual knowledge; failures must not leave a partial store.
Why: Today nodes of deleted files stay (RF-72) and kg add never deletes.
Where: src/kg/extract, src/kg/merge.py
Learned: Proposal: compare with a full rebuild of the parser layer (~1 s for 100 files) keeping llm/manual elements and warning about orphaned agent edges; moving/renaming = delete + add because IDs derive from paths.

nodes.label: Issue #38: kg query and kg impact (prio:v0.2)
nodes.description:
What: Lookups by ID/name/type, in/out relations with depth, impact exploration with relation chain and provenance; stable JSON.
Why: RF-40..42; agents should not read graph.json by hand.
Where: src/kg (new query module), CLI
Learned: kg impact must say 'may be affected', never present a possible effect as certain; guide must explain both commands.

nodes.label: Issue #39: reproducible benchmark, code vs. knowledge graph (prio:v0.2)
nodes.description:
What: Same model and 15-30 verifiable questions, baseline agent on code vs. agent on graph; accuracy, traceability, tokens, time, failures.
Why: Decide with data which queries benefit from the graph and at what cost.
Where: bench/ (outside the kg package)
Learned: Results orient but are not conclusive; separate quality from cost; mechanical grading preferred.

nodes.label: Issue #40: reproducible demo with queries on a real repo (prio:v0.2)
nodes.description:
What: Documented demo from source to three queries with reference answers, runnable without LLM credentials using examples/agent/*.json.
Why: Mostly covered by docs/examples and the report; missing piece is queries.
Where: docs/
Learned: Could be folded into #38's acceptance.

nodes.label: Decide how to clean the samples/basic-python-cli store with stale parser-provenance nodes
nodes.description:
What: Store has dependency:os, dependency:sys, document:README.md, document:LICENSE, entrypoint:size and old-model edges (file contains module) marked as parser though the extractor never produced them; options: recreate (init, extract, re-add agent knowledge as llm) or keep as is.
Why: They came from hand-written JSON in samples/basic-python-cli-kg/ added with parser provenance; kg add never deletes.
Where: samples/basic-python-cli/.kg (ignored by git)
Learned: User has not chosen; the assistant must not touch his store until then; kg remove/edit now make cleanup possible.

nodes.label: The .env GitHub token cannot configure Pages or repo administration (403)
nodes.description:
What: REST calls to configure GitHub Pages return 403 'Resource not accessible by personal access token'.
Why: Fine-grained token lacks Pages and Administration write permissions.
Where: GitHub REST API
Learned: User enabled Pages manually (Settings -> Pages -> main, /docs); to automate, the token needs Pages: RW and Administration: RW.
